indicators.name: Rainwater Permeable Surface Ratio
indicators.method: Permeable surface area / total urban area x 100

indicators.name: Rainwater Storage Capacity
indicators.method: Total rainwater storage capacity under municipal control / Total population

indicators.name: Building-Based Green Infrastructure Area
indicators.method: (Total green roof area + Total green wall area) / Population × 10,000

indicators.name: Total Climate-Adaptive Green Infrastructure Area
indicators.method: Total climate-adaptive green infrastructure area / Population

indicators.name: Number of Blue-Green Stormwater Systems (rain gardens, bioponds, etc.)
indicators.method: (Number of eligible blue-green stormwater management systems / Urban area in km²) × 100

indicators.name: Ecological Restoration Area (afforestration, habitat improvement stream restoration, wetland restoration, flood preventation, etc.)
indicators.method: (Ecologically restored area completed during the last five years / Total municipal administrative area) × 100

indicators.name: Household Rainwater Harvesting Ratio
indicators.method: (Number of registered households using rainwater harvesting systems / Total households) × 100

indicators.name: Number of Green Certified Buildings
indicators.method: (Number of buildings with valid recognised green building certification / Population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Coastal Green Infrastructure Length
indicators.method: (Length of coastline covered by qualifying coastal green infrastructure / Total coastline length within municipal boundaries) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal coastline length

indicators.name: Clean Fuel Usage Rate (biogas, hydrogen, biomethane, etc.)
indicators.method: (Energy from eligible clean fuels used in municipal heating and transport / Total fuel energy consumed in municipal heating and transport) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal heating and transport fuel consumption

indicators.name: Electricity Consumption per Capita
indicators.method: Total annual electricity consumption across all sectors within municipal boundaries / Total population

indicators.name: Energy Storage Capacity
indicators.method: (Total installed energy storage capacity within municipal boundaries / Total population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Natural Gas Consumption per Capita
indicators.method: Total annual natural gas consumption across all sectors within municipal boundaries / Total population

indicators.name: Energy-Efficient Building Ratio
indicators.method: (Number of municipal service buildings with energy performance certificate Class A or B / Total municipal service buildings) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal service buildings

indicators.name: SECAP (Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plan) Implementation Level
indicators.method: Assessment of the preparation, formal approval, implementation and monitoring of SECAP or an officially approved equivalent climate and energy action plan
thresholds: Advanced implementation and regularly monitored & evaluated >75

indicators.name: Share of Renewable Energy in Total Energy Consumption
indicators.method: (Renewable electricity generated or purchased with verified renewable origin and consumed in municipal facilities / Total electricity consumed in municipal facilities) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Share of total electricity consumption in municipal facilities

indicators.name: Number of Extreme Weather Events
indicators.method: (Total recorded climate-related extreme events during 2016–2025 / 10 / Population) × 10,000. Includes floods, storms, droughts, wildfires, heatwaves, hailstorms and rainfall-induced landslides, based on official disaster records.

indicators.name: Drought Risk Index
indicators.method: Municipal drought risk assessed using a common standardised methodology integrating meteorological, hydrological and land-use conditions

indicators.name: Number of Heatwave Days
indicators.method: Total number of days exceeding the officially defined heatwave threshold during 10 years / 10, based on national meteorological records

indicators.name: Number of Climate Adaptation Scenario Analyses
indicators.method: Number of distinct climate adaptation scenario studies or reports completed during last 5 years using GIS, climate modelling or decision-support tools. Each separate study or report is counted once.

indicators.name: Air Quality Index (AQI) (PM 2.5, PM 10, NO2, O2, SO2, CO, etc.)
indicators.method: Arithmetic mean of daily AQI values calculated according to the US EPA AQI methodology (PM₂.₅, PM₁₀, NO₂, O₃, SO₂ and CO) across all valid monitoring stations within municipal boundaries during last year

indicators.name: Ecological Footprint per Capita
indicators.method: Total municipal ecological footprint (gha), calculated using a harmonised ecological footprint accounting methodology / Total municipal population

indicators.name: Water Footprint
indicators.method: Total annual municipal water footprint (m³), calculated using a harmonised water footprint assessment methodology / Total municipal population

indicators.name: Carbon Sink Area
indicators.method: (Total area of forests, wetlands, grasslands, pastures and urban wooded areas within municipal boundaries / Total municipal administrative area) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Number of Carbon-Neutral Neighborhoods
indicators.method: (Number of officially recognised or certified carbon-neutral administrative neighbourhoods / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Built-up Area Ratio
indicators.method: (Total built-up area / Total municipal administrative area) × 100, using harmonised Copernicus CORINE Land Cover data
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Agricultural Land Ratio
indicators.method: (Total agricultural land area / Total municipal administrative area) × 100, using harmonised CORINE agricultural land classes
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Forest Area Ratio
indicators.method: (Total forest area / Total municipal administrative area) × 100, using harmonised CORINE forest land classes
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Natural Area Ratio
indicators.method: (Total area of natural grasslands, shrublands, wetlands, rocky habitats and dunes, excluding forests / Total municipal administrative area) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of non-forest natural ecosystems to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Brownfield Area Ratio
indicators.method: (Total area of previously developed but currently abandoned or unused land / Total urban area) × 100, based on verified municipal brownfield inventories)

indicators.name: Protected Area Ratio
indicators.method: (Total area legally protected under national legislation or designated as Natura 2000 sites within municipal boundaries / Total municipal administrative area) × 100, excluding overlapping protected areas
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Wetland Area
indicators.method: (Total wetland area within municipal boundaries / Total municipal administrative area) × 100, using harmonised CORINE wetland classes and verified national datasets
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Coastal Area Ratio
indicators.method: (Total natural coastal habitat area within a standardised 100 m inland coastal buffer / Total land area within the same coastal buffer) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of natural coastal habitat area to total coastal buffer area

indicators.name: Urban Water Stress Ratio
indicators.method: (Total annual water volume supplied to the municipal distribution network / Total annual allocated or licensed water volume from municipal supply sources) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Annual water demand / Available allocated water resources

indicators.name: Water Surface Ratio
indicators.method: (Total area of lakes, rivers, reservoirs and other inland surface waters / Total municipal administrative area) × 100, excluding marine waters
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Daily Water Consumption per Capita
indicators.method: Total annual water volume billed to residential subscribers (litres) / Total municipal population / 365
indicators.normalisation: Daily domestic water consumption per capita

indicators.name: Water Loss and Leakage Ratio
indicators.method: (Total system input water volume − Billed authorised water consumption) / Total system input water volume × 100, following the IWA water balance methodology
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of non-revenue water to total system input volume

indicators.name: Treated Wastewater Ratio
indicators.method: (Volume of collected municipal wastewater receiving treatment / Total wastewater volume collected through the sewerage system) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total collected municipal wastewater

indicators.name: Groundwater Usage Ratio
indicators.method: (Annual groundwater abstraction for municipal water supply / Total annual municipal water supply volume) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of groundwater abstraction to total municipal water supply

indicators.name: Modern Irrigation Ratio in Agriculture
indicators.method: (Agricultural land area using modern water-efficient irrigation systems / Total agricultural land area within municipal boundaries) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total agricultural land area

indicators.name: Water Resource Protection Area
indicators.method: (Total legally designated water resource protection area within municipal boundaries / Total municipal administrative area) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal administrative area

indicators.name: Water Storage Reserve Capacity
indicators.method: Total usable water storage capacity of municipally controlled reservoirs, dams and storage tanks (m³) / Average daily municipal water demand in 2025 (m³/day)
indicators.normalisation: Days of municipal water demand covered by available storage

indicators.name: Coastal Water Quality Index
indicators.method: Ecological status of coastal water bodies based on the EU Water Framework Directive or equivalent national classification. Where multiple coastal water bodies exist, the arithmetic mean of their status scores is calculated using the most recent official classification available as of last year.

indicators.name: Number of Marine Pollution Incidents
indicators.method: Total number of officially recorded marine pollution incidents affecting the municipal coastline during 2025, based on coast guard, port authority or environmental authority records
indicators.normalisation: Annual total of recorded marine pollution incidents

indicators.name: Municipal Solid Waste Generation per Capita
indicators.method: Total annual municipal solid waste collected (kg) / Total municipal population / 365. Includes household and household-like waste; excludes industrial, medical, and construction and demolition waste.
indicators.normalisation: Annual municipal solid waste generation / total population

indicators.name: Recycling Rate
indicators.method: (Municipal solid waste actually recovered as recyclable materials / Total municipal solid waste collected) × 100. Excludes composting, energy recovery and sorting residues.
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal solid waste collected

indicators.name: Composting Rate
indicators.method: (Total municipal organic waste processed through composting / Total municipal organic waste generated) × 100. Organic waste quantities shall be determined through waste composition analysis or estimated using national organic waste fractions.
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal organic waste

indicators.name: Amount of Electronic Waste Collected
indicators.method: Total annual electronic waste collected by municipal and authorised collection systems within municipal boundaries (kg) / Total municipal population
indicators.normalisation: Annual electronic waste collected per capita

indicators.name: Number of Hazardous Waste Collection Points
indicators.method: (Number of authorised collection points for batteries, waste oils, paints, solvents, medicines and fluorescent lamps / Total municipal population) × 10,000. Each physical collection point is counted once

indicators.name: Recycling and Recovery Facility Capacity
indicators.method: (Total annual installed capacity of licensed recycling and recovery facilities within municipal boundaries, in tonnes/year / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Number of Reuse and Repair Centers
indicators.method: (Number of operational reuse and repair centres operated by municipalities or registered through municipal permits and agreements / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Industrial Waste Recycling Rate
indicators.method: (Total industrial waste recycled / Total industrial waste generated within municipal boundaries) × 100, based on official industrial waste reporting systems
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total industrial waste generated

indicators.name: Number of Zero Waste Certified Institutions
indicators.method: (Number of institutions holding valid officially recognised zero-waste certification or an approved equivalent / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Sewage disposal
indicators.method: Classification according to the highest treatment stage applied to the largest share of collected municipal wastewater, based on operational wastewater treatment facilities and official records.

indicators.name: Rate of Waste Separated at Source
indicators.method: (Total weight of separately collected recyclable and organic municipal waste / Total municipal solid waste collected) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Share of separately collected waste in total municipal solid waste

indicators.name: Disaster Assembly Area Capacity
indicators.method: (Total population capacity of officially designated disaster assembly areas / Total municipal population) × 100. Capacity shall be calculated using a common project-wide minimum area standard (m²/person).
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of assembly area capacity to total municipal population

indicators.name: Number of Urban Flood Events
indicators.method: (Total number of officially recorded urban flood events during the reporting year / Total urban area in km²) × 100, based on municipal and fire department records
indicators.normalisation: Annual flood events per 100 km² urban area

indicators.name: Share of Built-up Area in Flood Zones
indicators.method: (Total built-up area located within 100-year return period flood hazard zones / Total built-up area within municipal boundaries) × 100, using EU Floods Directive hazard maps or equivalent national datasets
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of flood-exposed built-up area to total built-up area

indicators.name: Share of Built-up Area in Landslide Zones
indicators.method: (Total built-up area located within officially designated landslide hazard zones / Total built-up area within municipal boundaries) × 100, using national landslide hazard maps
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of landslide-exposed built-up area to total built-up area

indicators.name: Crisis Information Dissemination Time
indicators.method: Average time between the official emergency warning decision by the competent authority and the public dissemination of that warning through official communication channels during last year

indicators.name: Area Affected by Coastal Erosion
indicators.method: (Total length of coastline affected by documented coastal erosion / Total coastline length within municipal boundaries) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of eroded coastline length to total municipal coastline length

indicators.name: Coastal Flood Risk Area
indicators.method: (Total municipal land area exposed to coastal flooding according to official coastal flood hazard maps / Total municipal administrative land area) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of coastal flood-exposed area to total municipal administrative land area

indicators.name: Sea Level Rise Impact Area
indicators.method: (Total municipal land area projected to be affected by sea-level rise under an agreed climate scenario and target year / Total municipal administrative land area) × 100)
indicators.normalisation: Ratio of projected sea-level-rise impact area to total municipal administrative land area

indicators.name: Population Exposed to Poor Air Quality
indicators.method: (Population residing in areas where annual air pollutant concentrations exceed harmonised EU air quality limit values / Total municipal population) × 100, based on official air quality monitoring data and spatial population distribution

indicators.name: Population Exposed to Disaster Risk
indicators.method: (Number of socially vulnerable residents living within officially designated flood and landslide hazard zones / Total socially vulnerable population) × 100. Vulnerable groups include people aged 65 and over, children under 12, persons with disabilities and social assistance recipients. Individuals belonging to multiple groups shall be counted only once.
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total socially vulnerable population

indicators.name: Population Exposed to Heatwaves
indicators.method: (Number of socially vulnerable residents living in areas classified as having high heat exposure / Total socially vulnerable population) × 100, using urban heat island or land surface temperature maps and spatial population data
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total socially vulnerable population

indicators.name: Climate-Related Disease Rate
indicators.method: (Number of residents with clinically documented respiratory disease episodes attributable to climate-related hazards / Total municipal population) × 100, based on official health authority records, where reliable attribution data are available

indicators.name: Number of Air Quality Monitoring Stations
indicators.method: (Number of active air quality monitoring stations within municipal boundaries / Total municipal population) × 10,000. Includes municipal and national monitoring stations, excluding sensors counted under IN7.

indicators.name: Industrial Filtration Rate
indicators.method: (Number of industrial facilities equipped with certified and operational emission filtration systems / Total industrial facilities subject to emission filtration requirements within municipal boundaries) × 100, based on official environmental permits and records
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to industrial facilities subject to emission filtration requirements

indicators.name: Carbon Monitoring System
indicators.method: Assessment of the planning, implementation, operational coverage, digital monitoring and reporting of municipal greenhouse gas emissions. Measures the operational digital monitoring system rather than periodic carbon inventory reports.
thresholds: Pilot system monitoring a limited number of municipal facilities or emission sources
Partially operational system covering multiple facilities or emission sources
Fully operational digital system covering all relevant municipal emission sources with periodic reporting
Fully operational system with near-real-time monitoring, regular reporting and annual verification

indicators.name: Smart Water Meter Coverage
indicators.method: (Number of active water subscribers equipped with operational smart water meters / Total active municipal water subscribers) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total active municipal water subscribers

indicators.name: Number of Water Data Monitoring Stations
indicators.method: (Number of active hydrological and water quality monitoring stations within municipal boundaries / Total municipal administrative area in km²) × 100. Includes river discharge, river water level, groundwater level and water quality monitoring stations, regardless of operator.

indicators.name: Existence of Digital Waste Monitoring System
indicators.method: Assessment of the planning, implementation, operational coverage, integration and reporting capabilities of digital systems monitoring municipal waste generation, collection, transportation, recycling and treatment.
thresholds: Pilot digital monitoring of one waste stream or a limited service area
Partial implementation covering multiple waste streams or municipal service areas
Fully operational digital system covering all relevant municipal waste streams with regular reporting
Fully integrated digital system with real-time monitoring, automated data integration and regular reporting
indicators.normalisation: Digital waste monitoring system maturity level

indicators.name: Number of Smart Climate Monitoring Sensors
indicators.method: (Number of active IoT-based climate monitoring sensors within municipal boundaries / Total municipal administrative area in km²) × 100. Includes sensors monitoring temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind and other climatic parameters, excluding air quality monitoring devices counted under IN1.

indicators.name: Number of Coastal Monitoring Stations
indicators.method: (Number of active coastal environmental monitoring stations along the municipal coastline / Total municipal coastline length in km) × 100. Includes stations monitoring sea level, wave conditions, coastal water quality and other coastal environmental parameters.

indicators.name: Number of Climate and Environmental Awareness Campaigns
indicators.method: (Annual number of climate and environmental awareness campaigns / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Rate of Municipal Staff Trained on Climate Adaptation
indicators.method: (Municipal staff who completed climate adaptation training / Total municipal staff) × 100

indicators.name: Number of Climate Adaptation Training Programmes
indicators.method: (Annual number of distinct climate adaptation training programmes / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Number of Participants in Circular Economy Training
indicators.method: (Annual number of participations in circular economy training programmes / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Citizen Participation Rate in Climate Action Planning
indicators.method: (Number of citizens participating in formal climate action planning processes during 2023–2025 / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Participation Rate in Multi-Stakeholder Strategy Meetings
indicators.method: (Total stakeholder participations / Total stakeholder invitations) × 100

indicators.name: Number of Registered Disaster Volunteers
indicators.method: (Number of registered disaster volunteers / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Municipal Climate Adaptation Activities Targeting Refugees, Migrants and Linguistically Diverse Groups
indicators.method: (Annual number of climate adaptation activities targeting refugees, migrants and linguistically diverse groups / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Number of Languages in Which Climate Risk Information is Officially Communicated
indicators.method: Number of languages used for official climate risk communication

indicators.name: Number of Urban Greening Projects in Climate-Vulnerable Districts
indicators.method: (Number of urban greening projects in climate-vulnerable districts / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Share of Population Within 300 m of a Green or Cooling Space
indicators.method: (Residents living within 300 m of a green or cooling space / Total municipal population) × 100

indicators.name: Coverage of Social Support During Crisis
indicators.method: (Identified vulnerable persons receiving social support during an officially declared disaster or emergency / Total identified vulnerable persons) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total identified vulnerable persons

indicators.name: Disaster and Crisis Drill Intensity
indicators.method: (Annual number of disaster and crisis drills organised or joined by municipal units / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Post-Crisis Psychosocial Support Capacity
indicators.method: (Number of psychosocial support experts assigned or contracted for post-disaster response / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Disaster-Affected Persons (Sendai Framework Target B)
indicators.method: (Total number of persons directly affected by disasters during 2021–2025 / 5 / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Number of Crisis Management Partnerships
indicators.method: (Number of formal disaster and crisis management partnerships / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Share of Municipal Support Programmes Targeting Climate-Affected Small Businesses
indicators.method: (Municipal economic support programmes targeting climate-affected small businesses / Total municipal economic support programmes) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal economic support programmes

indicators.name: Number of Climate Adaptation Micro-Grants or Subsidies Distributed
indicators.method: (Number of climate adaptation micro-grants, subsidies or vouchers distributed / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Number of Green Job Training Programmes
indicators.method: (Annual number of green job training programmes / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Municipal Staff Density
indicators.method: (Total municipal staff / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Ratio of Technical/Expert Staff (Engineers, Architects, Urban Planners, Disaster Specialists, etc.)
indicators.method: (Technical/expert staff / Total municipal staff) × 100

indicators.name: Share of Staff Working in Critical Units (Climate, Disaster, Planning, Environment, etc.)
indicators.method: (Staff in critical units / Total municipal staff) × 100

indicators.name: Share of Personnel Assigned to Climate Change
indicators.method: (Staff assigned to climate change functions / Total municipal staff) × 100

indicators.name: SDG Alignment Rate
indicators.method: (Strategic objectives aligned with at least one SDG / Total strategic objectives) × 100

indicators.name: Rate of Digital Service Delivery
indicators.method: (Municipal services delivered online / Total municipal services) × 100

indicators.name: Digital Service Usage Rate
indicators.method: (Unique users of municipal e-services / Total internet users) × 100

indicators.name: Open Data Rate
indicators.method: (Open datasets / Total municipal datasets) × 100

indicators.name: Data Update Frequency
indicators.method: (Datasets updated at least once a year / Total municipal datasets) × 100

indicators.name: Rate of Use of Data-Driven Decision Systems
indicators.method: (Municipal units using data-driven decision systems / Total municipal units) × 100

indicators.name: Rate of Real-Time Data Usage
indicators.method: (Municipal services monitored with real-time data / Total municipal services) × 100

indicators.name: Rate of Digital Technology Use in Disaster and Crisis Management
indicators.method: (Disaster and crisis management operations using digital technologies / Total disaster and crisis management operations) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total disaster and crisis management operations

indicators.name: Rate of Digital Monitoring of Critical Infrastructure Systems
indicators.method: (Digitally monitored critical infrastructure systems / Total critical infrastructure systems) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total critical infrastructure systems

indicators.name: Rate of Climate Data Monitoring and Utilization
indicators.method: (Climate-related data types digitally monitored and used in planning / Total relevant climate data types) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total relevant climate data types

indicators.name: Participation Rate
indicators.method: (Number of participants in participatory processes / Total municipal population) × 100

indicators.name: Response Rate to Citizen Requests
indicators.method: (Citizen requests responded to / Total citizen requests received) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total citizen requests received

indicators.name: Rate of Policy Integration of Decisions from Participatory Processes
indicators.method: (Participatory inputs reflected in municipal policies / Total participatory inputs) × 100

indicators.name: Transparency Rate
indicators.method: (Publicly available municipal information, documents and datasets / Total municipal information, documents and datasets) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal information, documents and datasets

indicators.name: Climate Action Implementation Rate
indicators.method: (Completed climate actions / Total planned climate actions) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total planned climate actions

indicators.name: Number of Climate Actions per 10,000 People
indicators.method: (Total climate actions (planned, underway or completed) / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Level of Climate Governance Collaboration
indicators.method: Number of recognised climate governance networks with formal membership and active participation

indicators.name: Existence of Institutional Carbon Inventory
indicators.method: Maturity of municipal carbon inventory based on coverage, update frequency, verification, disclosure and GPC/IPCC alignment
thresholds: Comprehensive inventory covering all main sectors, regularly updated
Comprehensive, regularly updated inventory, third-party verified and publicly disclosed
Third-party verified and publicly disclosed comprehensive inventory covering Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, aligned with GPC/IPCC

indicators.name: Net Zero Target Progress Rate
indicators.method: (Achieved GHG emission reduction / Targeted GHG emission reduction) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to targeted GHG emission reduction

indicators.name: Disaster and Crisis Management Staff per 10,000 People
indicators.method: (Paid professional staff in municipal fire and civil protection services / Total municipal population) × 10,000

indicators.name: Emergency Response Time
indicators.method: Average response time to disaster and crisis events (lower is better)

indicators.name: Emergency Equipment Readiness Rate
indicators.method: (Available operational emergency equipment / Required emergency equipment) × 100

indicators.name: Time to Restore Critical Services After Disaster and Crisis
indicators.method: Average time required to restore critical municipal services (lower is better)

indicators.name: Risk-Based Planning Coverage Rate
indicators.method: (Risk-based emergency and disaster plans / Total emergency and disaster plans) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total emergency and disaster plans

indicators.name: Climate Risk Analysis and Mapping Coverage Rate
indicators.method: (Area covered by climate risk analyses and maps / Total identified risk area) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total identified risk area

indicators.name: Disaster Data Inventory Recording Rate
indicators.method: (Disaster records containing all mandatory information / Total disaster records) × 100

indicators.name: Existence of Crisis Management Center
indicators.method: Assessment based on operational capacity, staffing, equipment and governance
thresholds: Basic operational center with limited capacity
24/7 operational center with integrated communication systems and trained personnel
24/7 multi-hazard emergency management center with integrated communication systems, certified personnel, regular drills and performance evaluation

indicators.name: Digital Emergency Management System
indicators.method: Assessment of the planning, implementation, hazard coverage and integration of the municipal digital emergency management and coordination system
thresholds: Pilot implementation covering a limited number of hazards or a limited area
Fully operational system covering all relevant hazards
Fully operational system covering all relevant hazards with real-time data integration and coordination with other emergency actors
indicators.normalisation: Digital emergency management system maturity level

indicators.name: Green Bond Utilization Rate
indicators.method: (Annual green bond issuance / Total annual municipal debt financing) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal debt financing

indicators.name: Share of Climate Adaptation Expenditures Covered by Own Revenues
indicators.method: (Own-source revenues allocated to climate adaptation expenditure / Total climate adaptation expenditure) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total climate adaptation expenditure

indicators.name: Domestic Financing Provided for Climate Adaptation Projects (grants + loans)
indicators.method: (Total domestic grants + loans for climate adaptation projects / Total climate adaptation project financing (domestic + external)) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total climate adaptation project financing

indicators.name: External Financing Provided for Climate Adaptation Projects (grants + loans)
indicators.method: (Total external grants + loans (EU, international) for climate adaptation projects / Total climate adaptation project financing (domestic + external)) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total climate adaptation project financing

indicators.name: Disaster Financing Fund
indicators.method: (Annual amount allocated to the municipal disaster financing fund / Total annual municipal budget revenues) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total annual municipal budget revenues

indicators.name: Waste Reduction Expenditures
indicators.method: (Annual expenditures on waste prevention and reduction programs / Total municipal expenditure) × 100

indicators.name: Circular economy projects
indicators.method: Number of distinct circular economy projects initiated within the calendar year.

indicators.name: Circular Economy Expenditures
indicators.method: (Annual expenditures on circular economy initiatives (repair, reuse, upcycling, industrial symbiosis) / Total municipal expenditure) × 100

indicators.name: Procurements Including Circular Economy Criteria
indicators.method: (Number of procurement contracts including circular economy criteria / Total number of procurement contracts) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total number of procurement contracts

indicators.name: Recycled material usage rate
indicators.method: (Weight of recycled or secondary materials used in municipal operations / Total weight of materials consumed in municipal operations) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total weight of materials consumed

indicators.name: Total Expenditures for Natural Capital Protection
indicators.method: (Annual expenditures for ecosystem services, green/blue infrastructure and natural capital protection / Total municipal expenditure) × 100

indicators.name: Share of Smart City Investments in Total Investment Budget
indicators.method: (Annual budget for smart city / digital infrastructure (IoT, sensors, data platforms) / Total municipal investment budget) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal investment budget

indicators.name: Sustainable Transportation Investment Budget
indicators.method: (Annual budget for sustainable/low-carbon transport (cycling, pedestrian, EV, public transit) / Total municipal investment budget) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal investment budget

indicators.name: R&D Expenditures Focused on Environment and Circular Economy
indicators.method: (Municipal R&D expenditure on environmental protection and circular economy / Total municipal R&D expenditure) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal R&D expenditure

indicators.name: Preventive Investment Rate for Climate Risks (Share of investments aimed at reducing climate risks in total investments)
indicators.method: (Total annual municipal expenditure on climate risk prevention and reduction investments / Total annual municipal investment budget) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total annual municipal investment budget

indicators.name: Expenditures on Energy Efficiency
indicators.method: (Annual expenditures on energy efficiency upgrades (buildings, street lighting, equipment) / Total municipal expenditure) × 100

indicators.name: Annual Cost Savings Achieved through Energy Efficiency Measures
indicators.method: (Verified annual energy cost savings from efficiency measures / Baseline municipal energy expenditure) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to baseline municipal energy expenditure

indicators.name: Municipal Energy Expenditures
indicators.method: (Total annual municipal energy expenditure (electricity, heat, fuel) / Total annual municipal expenditure) × 100)

indicators.name: Investment Budget for Water Reuse
indicators.method: (Annual investment budget for water reuse and recycling infrastructure / Total municipal investment budget) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal investment budget

indicators.name: Share of Energy Generated from Waste in Total Municipal Energy Consumption
indicators.method: (Annual energy generated from waste-to-energy and biogas systems / Total annual municipal energy consumption) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total annual municipal energy consumption

indicators.name: Is Green Budgeting Implemented?
indicators.method: Is a green budgeting methodology applied to classify/tag budget lines by environmental impact?
thresholds: Full green budget with published report

indicators.name: Is participatory budgeting implemented?
indicators.method: Is participatory budgeting implemented allowing citizens to vote on municipal spending priorities?
thresholds: City-wide, annual, systematic and publicly reported

indicators.name: Share of Budget Allocated to Climate Adaptation
indicators.method: (Budget allocated to climate adaptation activities / Total annual municipal budget) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total annual municipal budget

indicators.name: Environmental Revenues in the Municipal Budget (taxes, fees, etc.)
indicators.method: (Environmental taxes + fees (pollution charges, waste levies, congestion pricing) / Total municipal revenues) × 100

indicators.name: Green Budget Transparency
indicators.method: Is the green budget publicly accessible online with environmental tagging methodology disclosed?
thresholds: Available on request only (not proactively published)
Full budget + methodology + audit trail published

indicators.name: Financial support provided for climate-aligned private sector investments
indicators.method: (Annual municipal financial support (grants, subsidies, guarantees, soft loans) for climate-aligned private sector investments / Total annual municipal financial support to the private sector) × 100
indicators.normalisation: Ratio to total municipal financial support to the private sector
